question.text: Negation of the statement: <math><msqrt><mn>5</mn></msqrt></math> is an integer or <math><mn>5</mn></math> is irrational is:

options.text: <math><msqrt><mn>5</mn></msqrt></math> is not an integer <math><mn>5</mn></math> is not irrational
<math><msqrt><mn>5</mn></msqrt></math> is not an integer and <math><mn>5</mn></math> is not irrational
<math><msqrt><mn>5</mn></msqrt></math> is irrational or <math><mn>5</mn></math> is an integer

solution.text: Using<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>~</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>p</mi><mo>∨</mo><mi>q</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mo>~</mo><mi>p</mi><mo>∧</mo><mo>~</mo><mi>q</mi></math>, we get negation of given statement as <math><msqrt><mn>5</mn></msqrt></math> is not an integer and <math><mn>5</mn></math> is not irrational Number.
